title: Our Sun's later chapter
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: After exhausting hydrogen in its core, the Sun is expected to expand into a red giant. Later, its outer layers will be shed and its core will remain as a white dwarf.

misconception: A learner may choose: A supernova immediately
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What is the Sun expected to become after its main-sequence phase?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What is the Sun expected to become after its main-sequence phase? A red giant. After exhausting hydrogen in its core, the Sun is expected to expand into a red giant. Later, its outer layers will be shed and its core will remain as a white dwarf.
